Your study tracks

Two guided tracks plus structured chapters and tests — learn in the order that builds lasting skill.

  • 🌱Basic Study trackThe fundamentals — basic tactics, opening principles, endgame patterns and essential strategy. The perfect starting point for beginners.
  • 🧠Positional Study trackGoes deeper into strategy — piece activity, weak squares, pawn structures, outposts and exchanges — for players ready to think positionally.
  • 📖Chapters & worked puzzlesEvery study is organised into clear chapters and worked puzzles, so you progress step by step and actually retain what you learn.
  • ✅Timed testsCheck that it's sticking — see which ideas you've truly mastered and which need another pass.

Why study with Chess Nexus

Random puzzles build speed, but structured study builds understanding. By learning concepts in a deliberate order — and testing yourself along the way — you turn scattered knowledge into real chess strength. It's a complete, beginner-friendly curriculum, free with no ads.

Frequently asked questions

Can I learn chess for free here?

Yes. Chess Nexus study covers tactics, openings, endgames and positional play in structured lessons — all completely free with no ads.

Is the study suitable for beginners?

Definitely. The Basic Study track is built for beginners, covering fundamentals from the ground up, while the Positional track challenges more advanced players.

How is chess study organised?

Studies are split into chapters and worked puzzles you complete in sequence, followed by timed tests so you can confirm what you've learned before moving on.
